rows: Decision: the page bindings the Node daemon relies on (`__mcpFocusChange`, `__mcpOpenedUrl`, `__mcpSetColorScheme`) call back into the daemon at any time, not only while a command is in flight, so the synchronous connection (which read the socket only inside `call`) could not carry them. `Cdp` now owns a reader thread: replies are routed to the waiting caller by id over a channel, events go into a bounded queue (10,000, oldest dropped), pings are answered from the reader, a lost connection wakes every waiting caller with an error, and a command times out after 60 s. `Attached` adds `add_binding` (`Runtime.addBinding`), `add_init_script` (`Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument`) and `take_binding_calls`; execution-context tracking now reads the queue, which removed the peek-based `drain`.
